notes: v568 — speed + consistency fix. The background grading ignored your 💧 tradeable-shares floor when deciding whether it needed to re-run, while the report card and the grade fetcher both respected it. Two consequences you felt: after changing the floor the radar sat on the OLD floor's grades until you manually opened the card, and the card then had to do a FULL re-grade the moment you opened it — the slow wait. Now all three agree: change the floor and the app re-grades itself once, quietly, in the background. A higher floor is also a much smaller job (about 478 shares at $1m versus 1,295 at the server floor), so it should feel quicker, not slower. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
